_meta._note: Chapter 34 final test (ch34-test, new — the old seventh lesson ch34-l07 stays as a DRAFT row at order 8, so its completions never count as this pass). Twelve multiple-choice questions, two per strand: now/habit, the prefixes (تَكْتُبُ always with a named subject), supplied new stems, لَا 'does not' versus 'Do not!' by meaning, object and time, and two integrated items (نَعْبُدُ as Chapter 10 retrieval). No future markers, no full paradigm. Pass mark 80 %: 9/12 fails, 10/12 passes. Rebuilt 2026-10-02 in the proposal harvest, batch 2 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-34-content-proposal.md and its review amendments: the imperfect in context — not 'only right now' but unfinished or habitual action, shown by الْآنَ / كُلَّ يَوْمٍ; five subject readings on one sound Form I model (أَكْتُبُ، نَكْتُبُ، يَكْتُبُ، and تَكْتُبُ for أَنْتَ and for هِيَ) — four prefix patterns, with تَكْتُبُ decided by context; transfer to supplied complete imperfects (يَذْهَبُ، يَجْلِسُ، يَعْلَمُ — the middle vowel is given, never guessed); لَا + imperfect for 'does not', with 'Do not!' (لَا تَجْلِسْ، 9:40 لَا تَحْزَنْ) as a recognition contrast only (Chapter 45 teaches it); an object, an object pronoun and a time word; review; 12-question test. نَعْبُدُ is Chapter 10 retrieval; نَسْتَعِينُ is glossed (root ع و ن). The future (سَـ / سَوْفَ) is Chapter 35; أَنْتِ forms are Chapter 37. The old Al-Fatiha capstone ch34-l07 is kept as a DRAFT row at order 8 so no earlier completion counts as passing the new test. Removed: 'present tense = right now', the six-row 'full table', four prefixes read as four subjects, أَفْعَلُ as a pattern for every verb, نَسْتَعِينُ under س-ع-ن, the ash-Sharh line cited as 1:6, نَرَانِي, many-to-one matching, multi-word build tiles and out-of-range reveal highlights.
